criteria.text: Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Pemberton Retail Group plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $350,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $204,650,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $204,300,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the Arden Industries Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $5,000,000 (3 x ($6,100,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $4,600,000 is wrong.

Identifies the threatened $1,200,000 claim by Hartwell Bioscience plc recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Flags that the disclosure letter is inconsistent with the material contract on change of control.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Pemberton Retail Group plc as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
